name: World of Hyatt Credit Card

apr.notes: Variable APRs; pricing terms list purchase APR 19.24% to 27.74% and cash advance APR 28.49%.

base_rate.description: 1 Bonus Point per $1 spent on all other purchases

categories.label: Qualifying purchases at Hyatt hotels and resorts
Restaurants, airline tickets purchased directly from airlines, local transit and commuting, fitness clubs and gym memberships

rewards.redemption_notes: World of Hyatt Bonus Points transfer automatically to the primary cardmember's World of Hyatt account; points do not expire as long as the card account is open.

signup_bonus.description: Earn 45,000 Bonus Points after spending $5,000 on purchases in the first 3 months from account opening, plus up to 30,000 more Bonus Points by earning 2 Bonus Points total per $1 spent in the first 6 months on purchases that normally earn 1 Bonus Point, on up to $15,000 spent.

benefits.title: Annual Category 1-4 Free Night Award
benefits.description: Receive one Free Night Award at a Category 1-4 Hyatt hotel or resort each year after the cardmember anniversary.

benefits.title: Additional Category 1-4 Free Night Award
benefits.description: Earn an additional Category 1-4 Free Night Award after spending $15,000 in purchases in a calendar year.

benefits.title: World of Hyatt Discoverist Status
benefits.description: Primary cardmembers receive World of Hyatt Discoverist status as long as the card account is open and not in default.

benefits.title: World of Hyatt Tier-Qualifying Night Credits
benefits.description: Receive 5 tier-qualifying night credits each calendar year and earn 2 additional tier-qualifying night credits for every $5,000 in purchases.

benefits.title: Baggage Delay Insurance
benefits.description: Reimbursement up to $100 a day for up to 5 days for essential purchases when baggage is delayed over 6 hours.

benefits.title: Lost Luggage Reimbursement
benefits.description: Reimbursement up to $3,000 per covered traveler for checked or carry-on baggage that is lost, damaged, or stolen during a covered trip.

benefits.title: Trip Cancellation and Interruption Insurance
benefits.description: Reimbursement up to $5,000 per covered traveler and $10,000 per trip for eligible prepaid, non-refundable travel expenses when a covered trip is canceled or interrupted.

benefits.title: Purchase Protection
benefits.description: Covers eligible new purchases against damage or theft for 120 days from the purchase date, up to $500 per item.

benefits.title: Auto Rental Coverage
benefits.description: Coverage for theft and collision damage for most rental vehicles when the rental company's collision insurance is declined and the full rental cost is charged to the card.

benefits.title: DoorDash DashPass
benefits.description: One year of complimentary DashPass for DoorDash and Caviar when activated by December 31, 2027, plus up to $10 off quarterly on eligible non-restaurant DoorDash orders through December 31, 2027.

other: Annual Category 1-4 Free Night Award after cardmember anniversary
5 World of Hyatt tier-qualifying night credits each calendar year
2 additional tier-qualifying night credits for every $5,000 in purchases

notes: Signup bonus is a tiered limited-time offer; see description for the official Chase spend requirements.
